// problem-code:client the gateway sent no Problem, so this writes one
const gateway = { status: 502, code: "gateway_unavailable" }; // want: gateway_unavailable
const quoted = "// problem-code:client inside a string vouches for nothing";
const smuggled = { status: 403, code: "smuggled" }; // want: smuggled
/* problem-code:client a block comment vouches for nothing */
const blocked = { status: 403, code: "blocked" }; // want: blocked
// problem-code:client
const reasonless = { status: 403, code: "reasonless" }; // want: reasonless
// problem-code:client the next line builds no Problem

const far = { status: 403, code: "far" }; // want: far

export function deny(code: string) {
  // problem-code:client a helper vouches only for its own literals
  return json({ title: "Denied", code }, 403);
}
